pr_title: Remember caption option in player, closes #2811
pr_body:
There had been feature requests like #1329 and #2392.
But instead of adding a new preference which seems to be generally not favourable, the request in #2811 seems actually pretty straight forward.
This PR implements it.

I have also considered the auto-generated subtitles (and hopefully internationalized, I have tested english and german phone languages). If auto-generated language was chosen last time by the user, the non auto-generated language will be preferred, but if the native chosen language is not available, the auto-generated variant will be used as a fallback.

Debug apk for testing: https://github.com/Redirion/NewPipe/releases/tag/v0.17.4cc

review_comments: What does `!userPreferredLanguage.contains("(")` do? Please add a comment to ensure people can understand your code later.
if the user already has set the auto-generated language (hence the check for "("), it is not useful to look for that as the first part of the if condition would match the caption language directly.
